description: IN-SITU CRASH WRECKAGE. A section of a B-52G shot down on the night of 27 December 1972 has lain in Huu Tiep Lake in Ngoc Ha village ever since and protrudes above the water; the lake has deliberately never been cleared; the site is heritage-listed; interpreted and walled for viewing and is a standing stop on Hanoi tours; OSM records the loss date 1972-12-27 explicitly; recorded as a display under the deliberate-retention-plus-public-presentation test and flagged as a wreck so nobody later mistakes it for a complete airframe
aliases: B52; B-52G; B52G; Stratofortress; Xac may bay B52
museum_name: Ho Huu Tiep B-52 Wreck -- Hanoi
